decisions.reason: As a compact dumper that builds directly on our established site-equipment know-how, it fits our engineering, service and customer base well, so we can improve it efficiently through in-house R&D rather than withdraw it.

The articulated construction dumper sits squarely within our existing product and service capabilities, which gives us strong absorptive capacity to interpret demand and refine the product at low strategic risk.

The underground mine rescue vehicle remains comparatively distant from our core knowledge base, and without clear evidence of strong traction its learning and improvement burden is high enough that resources are better reallocated.
The material lift is close to our established lifting business and the reported major order confirms market acceptance, making it a strong candidate for continued support and incremental development.

Although the compact underground mining loader is more distant from our traditional range, its intensive early use provides valuable operational feedback that our R&D organisation can absorb and turn into product improvements.
